title: Moral Letters
subtitle: Stoic philosophy, rewritten as letters to someone I love
intro: Based on Seneca's letters to Lucilius, written almost two thousand years ago. I've used AI to help transform them — keeping the meaning, updating the language, and cutting the references that meant something in Rome but nothing now. What's left is easier to actually read, and closer to how it must have felt the first time: not a lecture, but a letter, written to someone in particular.
